subtitle: Out Manila · Fly + cruise
overview: A fly and cruise package: you fly from Manila to Guangzhou, tour the city for half a day, then board the 141,900-ton Adora Flora City for five nights at sea with calls at Hong Kong and Ishigaki in Okinawa, Japan. After disembarking back in Guangzhou you enjoy another half-day city tour before flying home to Manila. Rooms are twin sharing in your chosen cabin type.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 11–16 2027 to Jan 11–16 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Guangzhou: The major port city of southern China, with the half-day city tours at the start and end of this trip.
placeDesc.Huacheng Square: A large public square in Guangzhou's Zhujiang New Town, surrounded by modern landmarks.
placeDesc.Canton Tower: Guangzhou's slender landmark tower on the Pearl River, seen here on a photo stop.
placeDesc.Yongqingfang: A restored historic lane in Guangzhou's Xiguan area, with old Cantonese buildings, cafes and shops.
placeDesc.Shamian Island: A small riverside island in Guangzhou with European-style colonial buildings and tree-lined streets.
placeDesc.Nansha Port: Guangzhou's cruise port, where passengers board the ship after the city tour.
placeDesc.Ishigaki: The main island of Japan's Yaeyama group in Okinawa, known for beaches and clear water.
placeDesc.Yaeyama Islands: A group of subtropical islands in Okinawa, Japan, known for white-sand beaches and snorkeling.
placeDesc.Adora Flora City: Adora Cruises' 141,900-ton cruise ship used for this fly-and-cruise trip.
